BAD_REQUEST: We could not process the request. Try again and, if it keeps happening, update the app.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Something is not in the expected format. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The app and the server did not understand each other. Update AccioPass and try again.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This is too large to send in one go. Shorten it and try again.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session is not active. Sign in again to continue; your vault is still available on this device.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Try again and, if nothing changes, sign in again.
TOKEN_INVALID: We could not validate your session. Sign in again to keep syncing.
SESSION_REVOKED: This session was closed, perhaps from another device. Sign in again to keep syncing; your vault is still here.
REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.
REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED: We closed this session for your security. Sign in again and, if you do not recognise the activity, review your devices in Settings.
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The e-mail or the master password does not match. Check them and try again.
TWO_FACTOR_INVALID: The code is not correct. Make sure it is the current one and type it again.
CHALLENGE_INVALID: This attempt is no longer valid: it expired or your account changed in the meantime. Start again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your e-mail is not verified yet. We have sent you a new code: enter it to continue.
IP_BLOCKED: Requests from your network are blocked for a while after too many failed attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN: AccioPass cannot be used from here. Open the official app or website.
REAUTH_REQUIRED: Confirm your master password to continue.
ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED: Your account is read-only: you can view, copy and export your data, but not change it.
AI_DISABLED: AI is turned off for this in your account. You can turn it on in Settings.
API_KEY_INVALID: The API key is not valid, has expired or was revoked. Create a new one in Settings.
API_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED: This can only be done from the app while signed in, not with an API key.
INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: The API key does not have permission for this. Create one with the permission you need.
DEVICE_REVOKED: This device was deauthorised. Sign in again to use it.
LOGIN_DENIED: The sign-in was rejected from another of your devices. If that was you, try again.
NOT_FOUND: We cannot find it. It may have been deleted on another device.
ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: This feature is not available on the server. Update the app and try again.
API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This version of the app is not compatible with the server. Update AccioPass.
API_VERSION_SUNSET: This version of AccioPass can no longer connect. Update the app to keep syncing; your vault is still available on this device.
CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This version of AccioPass can no longer connect. Update the app to keep syncing; your vault is still available on this device.
RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find anyone on AccioPass with that e-mail. Check the address; they may have no account or may not allow being found by e-mail.
CONFLICT: Someone changed this in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
VERSION_CONFLICT: There is a newer version of this item. Review the changes and save again.
OAUTH_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: An account with that e-mail already exists. Sign in with your master password and link the provider in Settings, under Linked accounts.
OAUTH_IDENTITY_IN_USE: That provider account is already linked to another AccioPass account.
OAUTH_PROVIDER_ALREADY_LINKED: You already have another account of this provider linked. Unlink it first in Settings.
REGISTRATION_SUPERSEDED: This registration was replaced by a newer one for the same e-mail. Register again.
TWO_FACTOR_SETUP_REQUIRED: Start the two-step verification setup again before turning it on.
APPROVAL_RESOLVED: This request was already answered or has expired.
APPROVAL_NUMBER_INVALID: That is not the number shown on the device that is signing in. Look at its screen before choosing.
CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Request a new one.
CODE_INVALID: The code is not correct. Check it and type it again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. For your security, wait a few minutes before trying again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached today’s limit for this feature. You can use it again tomorrow.
LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the maximum allowed. Remove something you do not need and try again.
OAUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED: This sign-in provider is not available. Use another one or your master password.
OAUTH_FAILED: The provider did not complete the sign-in. Try again.
OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: This sign-in attempt has expired. Start again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something failed on our server. It is not your fault: try again later.
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we depend on is not responding right now. Try again later.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is not available at the moment. Try again in a few minutes.
OFFLINE: There is no connection to AccioPass. This needs the internet: try again when you are back online.
WRONG_PASSWORD: The master password is not correct. Type it again.
LOCKED: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
INVALID_RECOVERY_PHRASE: The recovery words do not match. Check that all 24 are there, in order and without typos.
INVALID_OTP_URI: That QR code or link is not from an authenticator. Scan it again or type the key by hand.
INVALID_INPUT: Something is not valid. Check it and try again.
READ_ONLY: This item is read-only for you. Ask the person sharing it to let you edit it.
STORAGE_FULL: There is no space left on this device to save the change. Free some space and try again.
UNSUPPORTED: This is not available on this device.
INVALID_RESPONSE: We received an unexpected answer. Check your connection (some Wi-Fi networks ask you to sign in) and try again.
ITEM_TOO_LARGE: This item is too large to sync. It is still saved on this device: shorten the notes and it will be sent.
ITEM_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the maximum number of items in your account. This one is still saved on this device: delete one you do not use so it can sync.
DATA_REQUIRED: We could not send this item. It is still saved on this device: open it and save it again.
